CHINADAILY
中国日报 | www.chinadaily.com.cn
began to get a little less dark in 1477, when Archduke Maximilian of Austria commissioned[5] an extravagant diamond ring for his new wife. The accessory[6] grew in popularity in the Victorian era, and gradually the diamond ring trend trickled down[7] from nobility to the masses.
米兰主公给新婚妻子定制了一枚奢侈的钻石戒指，自那以后订婚戒指的含义就没那么阴暗了。订婚戒指在维多利亚时代变得越发流行，订婚钻戒的习俗也从贵族流传到了民间。
[1] twisted 美 /ˈtwɪstɪd/
adj. mentally or emotionally unsound or disturbed 扭曲的
She gave a small twisted smile.
她不不自然地微微一笑。
[2] gem 美 /dʒem/
n. (also gemstone) a precious stone that has been cut and polished and is used in jewellery （经切割打磨的）宝石
[3] anthropologist 美 /ˌænθrəˈpɒlədʒɪst/ n. 人类学家
[4] date back to... /date from... 追溯到；始于；自…至今
The college dates back to medieval times.
这所学院创办于中世纪。
[5] commission 熟词僻义
v. to officially ask sb to write, make or create sth or to do a task for you 正式委托（谱写或制作、创作、完成）
Publishers have commissioned a French translation of the book.
出版商已委托人把这本书译成法语。
[6] accessory 美 /əkˈsesəri/
